newsitem.title: USA: Reno Air says June a profitable month.
newsitem.headline: Reno Air says June a profitable month.

text.p: Reno Air said Tuesday that June was its only profitable month in the second quarter. The regional airline said profits were similar to those reached in June of 1996.
Reno reported second quarter net income of $0.02 per share, or $224,375 down from $0.28 per share, or $3.2 million during the same period a year earlier.

Commenting on the improved results, Reno Air's president and chief executive officer, Robert Reding said, "The return to the prior year's profit levels in June is especially encouraging in light of our lack of aircraft availability during the month due to our engine difficulties and the fact that we are entering what has traditionally been Reno Air's strongest quarter."
Reding said in a statement that the airlines bookings are strong and it expects its yield to continue to outperform last year.
